audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why is garbled ('Avengerang... no —') and calls Akshan's R 'Vengeance'. spikes[2] is built entirely on wrong items: it credits 'Sundered Sky's crit/hp package' to Akshan (Sundered Sky is neither crit nor an Akshan item) and names 'Terminus or Youmuu's on her'. spikes[1] claims Comeuppance 'erases Irelia's flash or ult from across the map', which is not a thing any ability does.
audit.why: Comeuppance locks onto a champion, stores bullets and fires for damage scaling on missing health at 2500 range. It does not remove summoners or ultimates. Vanguard's Edge is 125/105/85s — that long rank-1 cooldown is the real late-game spike to track.
audit.corrected: Item speculation replaced with kit facts that do not go stale: the 600-range walk-up, the missing-health execute, and the 125-second Vanguard's Edge.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three mechanical errors and one large omission. (a) early says 'her Q Bladesurge only resets off enemies or terrain' — Bladesurge refreshes when its target is MARKED or dies to it, and nothing about terrain. (b) mid says her Q resets chain 'near a wall', same error. (c) spikes[3] and late tell you to 'hit-and-run with E resets off enemy champions' — Heroic Swing has no reset; it hooks terrain and is knocked off by colliding with champions. (d) wants.you[2] says to track 'her ult charge (blade stacks)'; Vanguard's Edge has no charge or stacks. OMISSION: Defiant Dance (W) reduces the PHYSICAL damage she takes while charging, and Akshan's damage is entirely physical — the page never mentions it.
audit.why: The Marked mechanic is the actual engine of the matchup: Flawless Duet stuns and Marks, and a Marked target refreshes Bladesurge, so one landed stun turns into a chain of free 600-range dashes at 15 mana each. That is why dodging the E matters, and the page only said 'dodge it and the dive falls apart' without the reason. Defiant Dance is the second unstated lever: trading into a charging W gives her reduced damage from your entire kit. Also from missingInteractions, Bladesurge heals her, so Grievous Wounds decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: Marked-refresh mechanic stated in ahead, enemyWin, early and mid. Defiant Dance's physical damage reduction added to breakdown.carry, mid and spikes[2]. Akshan E reset claims removed. Anti-heal promoted into breakdown.carry and late.

edits.before: You out-range every part of Irelia's early kit — her Q Bladesurge only resets off enemies or terrain, and if you just hold max Q Avengerang distance she has nothing but auto trades to offer. Whiff-punish her Q dashes into minions with your own Q, and use E to reposition the instant she flashes to your side of the wave. She can't force anything before level 3 unless you overextend, so play the poke game and let your passive stacks pile up on her.
edits.after: You out-range every part of Irelia's early kit — Bladesurge reaches only 600 and refreshes only when its target is Marked or dies, so while you are unmarked it is a 10-second cooldown every time. Hold max Avengerang distance and she has nothing but auto trades to offer. Whiff-punish her dashes into minions with your own Q, and swing away the instant she reaches your side of the wave. She cannot force anything before level 3 unless you overextend.

edits.before: From level 6 onward Comeuppance turns every Irelia all-in into a coinflip she loses if she doesn't kill you outright, since a botched dive just eats her flash and ult to your R. Keep baiting her stun (E) into your own E swing so you're never standing still when her passive procs, and never let her get three autos on you near a wall where her Q resets chain. Roams matter here too — Irelia has no real gap-close onto a fleeing target while you can E Heroic Swing to a river bush and threaten a global R elsewhere.
edits.after: From level 6 onward Comeuppance turns every Irelia all-in into a coinflip she loses if she doesn't kill you outright, since a botched dive costs her Flash and her health bar. Bait Flawless Duet before you ever step up, and never let it land — a Marked target refreshes Bladesurge, so one stun becomes a chain of free dashes. Don't trade into a charging Defiant Dance either: it cuts the physical damage your whole kit deals. Roams matter here too — she has no gap-close onto a fleeing target.

edits.before: Sundered Sky or Trinity Force doesn't fix Irelia's core problem versus you: she still has to walk down your Q poke and E disengage to land a stun, and if she ever gets picked off by your ult she's just dead. In teamfights, dive her stunners' targets, hit-and-run with E resets off enemy champions, and save R for whichever backline threat surfaces — Irelia will be busy trying to find an isolated pick instead of contributing to the real fight.
edits.after: Sundered Sky or Trinity Force doesn't fix Irelia's core problem versus you: she still has to walk down your Q poke and E disengage to land a stun, and if she ever gets picked off by your ult she's just dead. In teamfights keep a wall behind you so Heroic Swing always has an anchor, carry Grievous Wounds against her Bladesurge healing, and save R for whichever backline threat surfaces — Irelia will be hunting an isolated pick instead.

notes: Largest correction set of my slice. Full layer said Irelia won all seven rows while the content layer said Akshan won all seven; packet.levelChart agrees with content, so the full side was flipped as one atomic group. Four mechanical errors fixed: (1) 'Bladesurge only resets off enemies or terrain' — it refreshes off Marked or dying targets, terrain is not involved; (2) the same error repeated in mid as 'near a wall where her Q resets chain'; (3) spikes[3] and late told the reader to use 'E resets off enemy champions' — Heroic Swing has no reset and is in fact knocked off by colliding with a champion; (4) wants.you[2] told the reader to track 'her ult charge (blade stacks)', which Vanguard's Edge does not have. spikes[2] was also built on items that do not belong to either champion in that role (Sundered Sky described as Akshan's 'crit/hp package', 'Terminus on her'), so it is now grounded in ranges instead. The unstated interaction I added: Defiant Dance reduces PHYSICAL damage while charging, and Akshan's damage is entirely physical — trading into the charge is a direct loss, and no field mentioned it. Anti-heal against Bladesurge, flagged in missingInteractions, added to breakdown.carry and late. NOT changed, and raised as a question instead: diff 'HARD' / diffRating 8/10 / carryRating 8.5/10 contradict an Akshan-x7 chart and a 51.95% win rate, but re-rating means moving diff, diffRating, carryRating, tone, breakdown.difficulty and report[14] together and I would be guessing the target values.
